primary_contribution: A testable policy for choosing between resolving shared assay-context evidence, revealing supported molecular measurements, recommending and abstaining, evaluated by reference-endpoint discovery on held-out reviewed family/source units with a fixed predictor.
novelty_status: NOT_ESTABLISHED; distinguish from decision-region determination and multifidelity active search before any method claim

family_policy.primary_unit: Reviewed protein-level family membership supported by a pinned family-type annotation and an assayed-chain/domain-architecture check; unresolved mapping is UNKNOWN
family_policy.adjudication_source: Existing versioned InterPro family-type / UniProt family assertions and their provenance; additional missing records require separate access approval or lawful owner-supplied snapshots
family_policy.shared_domain_edges: Retain as homology warnings and isolation constraints until qualified review; never remove a legacy protection/exposure edge

isolation_policy.mixed_historical_role_component: QUARANTINE_NEW_TASKS; preserve old records and roles

exposure_policy.catalog_metadata: Common design metadata; does not itself constitute activity or reference-gold exposure; never downgrade an existing exposure declaration
exposure_policy.dqr_identity_and_frame_carry_forward: Carry all returned DQR canonical identities and inspected task/source dependencies; preserve any old final provenance as protected/quarantined, not relabeled development

reference_unit.default: One assay context and one endpoint type

sampling.intent_rule: Reference-capable targets first using outcome-free nominal support, then fixed hash; no potency or numerical-presence selection
sampling.auxiliary_search: One to three distinct contexts; a heuristic search cannot certify absence of an eligible combination

estimand.population: Qualified finite historical panels meeting the predeclared reference, support and isolation rules; not all ChEMBL, a prospective library or clinical efficacy
estimand.primary_utility: Proportion of a task's ten strongest reference-panel compounds recovered among delivered reference measurements
estimand.primary_contrast: Family/source-unit macro-average paired difference versus the strongest preregistered resource-feasible same-predictor control; chosen using development/validation only
estimand.uncertainty: Unit-level paired effects and intervals; repeated seeds remain within-unit repetitions
estimand.meaningful_effect_threshold: NOT_SET_BY_OWNER; no confirmatory benefit claim from a favorable point estimate
estimand.final_power_or_precision_plan: REQUIRED_LATER; 12 final units are a target, not a power guarantee

comparison_contract.unknown_fact_response: UNRESOLVED; charge the attempted action, do not fabricate truth

remaining_decisions.resolution: Approve or revise this precise claim, family/exposure policy and support-first sampling proposal

remaining_decisions.owner: two qualified reviewers nominated by owner

Separate approval for a restricted validator after frozen candidates and protection review; no planner magnitudes
